steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A logo must work at ALL scales — from a billboard to a favicon; simplicity and clarity are key. | Key Fact: Brand guidelines document: logo usage rules, colour palette (Pantone, CMYK, RGB), typography, imagery style, spacing requirements. | Key Fact: Consistency across all applications builds recognition — stationery, packaging, digital, signage must all speak the same visual language. | Key Fact: Rebranding involves updating an existing identity — it must balance familiarity with freshness.
